design_system.target_context: One-Page Gamified Operational App / Cyber-Industrial Artisan Bakery Dashboard
design_system.vibe: Futuristic, cosmic, high-contrast, tactile command center mixing real master bakers and VR/visor cyber-robots.

architecture_and_hub_structure.page_layout: Single-Page Operational Hub with 3 Avatar Portals (Planets) + 3 dedicated slide/overlay interactive sections

header.style: Glassmorphism sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800/80 z-50
components: 6-Language Selector Dropdown (IT / DE / EN / ES / FR / FA) with flags & local names

home_hub_planets.concept: Three large glowing circular avatar portals with floating/orbiting action bubbles on a dark cosmic starfield background

section_1_capo.title: Capo Laboratorio - Scaletta Logica Produzione
section_1_capo.vibe: Logical Ladder with big tactile cards and high visual feedback for fast bakery shift operations.
layout_components: Interactive Production Summary Banner (Active Batch, Dough Temp, Shift Progress)

Logical Ladder Steps: Step 1 (Weekly Plan / Piano Settimanale), Step 2 (Recipes & Doses / Ricette), Step 3 (Dough Twin & Fermentation Control), Step 4 (Warehouse Stock & Batches), Step 5 (Extra Orders & Sales Points)
Big Touch Buttons with data-testid attributes for testing

section_2_mohamed.title: Mohamed - Production Hands-Free Command Center
section_2_mohamed.vibe: Ultra-minimalist, zero-friction hands-free operational surface. Single giant interactive microphone avatar button.
layout_components: Giant Glowing Mic Avatar Button with soundwave ripples and state ring (Idle / Listening / Speaking)
Real-time voice transcript & audio feedback visualizer
Quick Voice Shortcut Chips (e.g. 'Avvia Impasto Baguette', 'Temperatura Acqua 18°C', 'Timer 12 Minuti')

section_3_bakemix.title: Bakemix - AI Mind & Guided System Explainer
section_3_bakemix.vibe: Interactive cinematic guide player where Bakemix acts as the site mind, presenting step-by-step documentation, PDFs, and system walkthroughs.
layout_components: Cinematic Guide Player with interactive chapter steps (Intro, Capo System, Hands-Free Voice, Offline Sync, Document PDF Export)
Live System Diagnostics & Document Viewer (Download Inventory PDF / Functional Spec)

motion_and_interactions.orbit_animation: Framer motion continuous rotation and pulse for floating action bubbles around avatar planets
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: Hover scale 1.02 with glowing border highlight transition ease-out 0.2s
motion_and_interactions.mic_pulse: Expanding concentric ring pulse when voice assistant is active
motion_and_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: Supported via CSS media query and Framer Motion reducedMotion prop

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure dark cosmic aesthetic (#030712) with cyan/teal/amber neon accents.
Do not duplicate legacy headers or duplicate section wrappers.
All interactive elements must have clear data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='lang-selector-select', data-testid='capo-recipe-ladder-button').
Use glassmorphism with backdrop blur for headers and modals, avoiding total transparent backgrounds.
Ensure clean 6-language switcher support (IT, DE, EN, ES, FR, FA) with RTL adjustments for FA if active.
instructions_to_main_agent: Use this blueprint to build/update the CyberBakeryTrio home hub and its 3 section views in App.js and components. Maintain offline-first capability and ensure mobile viewport (390px) and desktop layouts are fluid, high-contrast, and responsive.
